items.text: My teacher gave it back with "intercept??", "is reaction time really the cause?", "uncertainty in k far too small" and "what does the static check actually tell you" written in the margin and I honestly don't get what she wants.

Can you go through it properly: redo the numbers yourself (T and T squared for each mass, the gradient, k, the intercept, and a realistic uncertainty in k with working), then tell me specifically which of my sentences are wrong and why.
If the intercept is not reaction time then what is it physically, and can I actually use it for something?
Also she said this section is marked on Data analysis and Conclusion (6 marks each) so roughly where would mine sit at the moment?
Please don't just say "add more detail", I need to know what is actually wrong.
